using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Scoping;

public class Counter
{
    private int total;

    public int Add(int amount)
    {
        int total = amount;
        for (int i = 0; i < amount; i++)
        {
            total += i;
        }
        this.total += total;
        return this.total;
    }

    public static IEnumerable<int> Evens(int limit)
    {
        for (var n = 0; n < limit; n += 2)
        {
            yield return n;
        }
    }

    public string Label(object value) => value switch
    {
        int number => "int " + number,
        string text => text,
        _ => "other",
    };
}
